steps.purpose: Confirm the candidate artifacts and installer metadata match the release manifest before touching the machine.
steps.expected: Both commands pass for the same candidate build.

steps.purpose: Install the NSIS candidate in a clean Windows VM or disposable test account.
steps.expected: Installer completes without error and the app can be found from Start or the install directory.

steps.purpose: Optional unattended NSIS install check for repeatable QA environments.
steps.expected: Process exits successfully. If this differs from the interactive install, record the difference in the QA log.

steps.purpose: Probe the default per-user Tauri NSIS install location and launch if present.
steps.command: $exe = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Compose Tutor Studio\Compose Tutor Studio.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe) { Start-Process -FilePath $exe } else { Write-Host "Expected exe not found: $exe" }
steps.expected: Compose Tutor Studio opens. If installed elsewhere, launch from Start and note the actual path.

steps.purpose: Uninstall the NSIS candidate after launch checks.
steps.command: $uninstaller = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Compose Tutor Studio\uninstall.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller) { Start-Process -FilePath $uninstaller -ArgumentList '/S' -Wait -PassThru } else { Write-Host 'Use Windows Settings > Installed apps to uninstall.' }
steps.expected: The app is removed and no stale Start/menu shortcut remains for this candidate.

steps.purpose: Install the MSI candidate in a clean Windows VM or disposable test account.
steps.expected: msiexec exits successfully and the app can be launched from the installed location or Start.

steps.purpose: Uninstall the MSI candidate by ProductCode after launch checks.
steps.expected: msiexec exits successfully and the app is removed from Windows installed apps.
